title: Magazine p. 56: Retouched Gemini-7 "two lights" forgery vs. original NASA S65-63722
description: Photocopied magazine page comparing two photographs. Photo 27, showing two bright round lights at lower edge, is captioned "Forgery can be reprinted in spite of copyright regulations because this is a NASA photo. Even retouched, it cannot be copyrighted." Photo 28 is captioned "Gemini-7 photo of sunlight glinting off roll thruster rockets on nose. Photo forgers airbrushed the nose/Earth boundary out, making the two lights appear to be floating in space. NASA photo S65-63722," with a handwritten note "PHOTO ALSO REVERSED."
